answer: Quadratic-priced audit lottery. Each identity registers at the knoll registry with a refundable 2-unit cedar bond escrowed 12 epochs. Each epoch a beacon draws 5 percent of identities for audit; audited agents reveal their referral graph in 48 hours. Skipping burns the bond; failing also forfeits prior tickets priced quadratically: ticket n costs n^2 * 0.25 units, so four cost 10 units. Forfeits enter the wharf queue. An attacker running 100 identities posts 200 units; a flagged cluster loses those bonds plus 1,000 in tickets, so inflation never pays.
